scenes.setting_guess: inside the panic room (burglars now inside with Hollis); Bram outside on the intercom
scenes.summary: The positions had flipped: the burglars were now inside the panic room with Hollis while Bram, outside, screamed that her daughter needed her medicine. Learning that without the injection Hollis could fall into a coma and die, Lena decided to give her the shot himself despite Milo.

beats.text: Positions flip: the burglars are locked in the panic room with Hollis while Bram is outside with the medicine
Told Hollis could fall into a coma and die, Lena insists on giving her the injection

scenes.summary: Lena gave Hollis the shot while confessing he was a desperate gambler who had lost his house, car and wife; Hollis recovered, and Milo sneered that he had only saved her for ten minutes.

beats.text: Lena injects Hollis and saves her, confessing that gambling debts drove him to crime
Milo: 'You saved her life for ten minutes' — he means to kill her

moments.what: Lena's bad-cards confession while saving the girl

scenes.summary: Police arrived after the father's call. Watched on the monitors by the burglars holding her daughter, Bram convinced the officers nothing was wrong with an embarrassing lie about a drunk call to her ex, and they left.

beats.text: Police arrive, but with her daughter held hostage Bram lies and sends them away

humor.joke: the 'three things I'll do for you' cover story

moments.what: officer offers a secret signal; Bram declines

scenes.summary: Milo announced the witnesses must die — the kid now, the other two later — and Lena refused; the safe was finally being opened.

beats.text: Milo plans to kill all three witnesses; Lena refuses

scenes.summary: In the chaotic finale someone broke through a wall from the neighbor's house; Bram turned the burglars' own gun on them, and Lena grabbed the money and ran as Milo shouted after him. (Physical action is largely absent from the dialogue; details are inferred.)

beats.text: Final showdown: Bram gets hold of the gun and fights back
Lena grabs the money and flees

humor.joke: 'WHO BREAKS IN THROUGH THE NEIGHBOR'S HOUSE?!'

scenes.summary: Later, mother and daughter browsed real-estate listings and wondered where they would live now.

humor.joke: house-hunting again after the house from hell

story_so_far: Bram and her diabetic daughter Hollis hide in a panic room from burglars Rufus, Lena and Milo, who want fourteen million dollars in its safe. After failed calls for help, Hollis's sugar crashes; Milo takes control and the captured father is beaten. Positions flip: the burglars end up inside the room with Hollis while Bram has the medicine; Lena saves Hollis with the injection. Bram sends the police away to protect her daughter. Milo plans to kill all witnesses; in the final fight Bram turns the gun on him, Lena runs with the money and is stopped by police. Later mother and daughter look for a new home.
